text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus gave it everything she had. 
She truly realized just how special the 
Classic races were— a stage one could only 
stand upon once in a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who entered the race fought 
fiercely as if staking everything they 
had. Ikuno Dictus felt that passion 
without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. The Trainer suggested the Flora 
Stakes as the next target race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Yushun Himba (Oaks) is 2,400m—800m 
longer than the Oka Sho. We needed to 
confirm whether Ikuno Dictus could go the 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Flora Stakes, a trial race for the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks), is 2,000m—the perfect 
race to test one's medium-distance 
aptitude.
